info.name: Carrivo API
info.description: REST API for the Carrivo courier & logistics platform. All routes are under {{baseUrl}} (= http://localhost:5000/api/v1 locally).

request.description: Liveness check. Always 200 while the server is up; `data.database` reports `up` or `down`.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Shows the error envelope returned for unknown routes.

response.name: 404 Not Found

item.name: Auth
item.description: Email/password auth (Better Auth + bearer plugin). Send the returned `data.token` as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Login/register are rate limited: 20 failed attempts per 15 min per IP.

request.description: Self-registration always creates a CUSTOMER. Unknown fields (e.g. `role`) are rejected. Returns a session token (auto sign-in).
